name: Studies and School
description: discuss education, studying, and school life
author: IELTS Practice Team

questions.text: Do you think students today have more pressure at school than students in the past?
What subjects do you think are most useful for students to study?
Do you think schools should focus more on practical skills or academic subjects?
How has technology changed the way students study?
Do you think students learn better when they study alone or with other students?
